subject: science
skillName: Energy in Motion and in Fields

items.prompt:
Energy can be the motion of particles or energy stored in
A) fields
B) names
C) colors
D) prices

steps: Energy is motion of particles or stored in fields.

items.prompt:
A moving object's energy is
A) kinetic (motion) energy
B) stored in a field
C) potential energy
D) chemical energy

steps: A moving object has kinetic energy.

items.prompt:
A hot object's fast-moving particles represent
A) thermal energy (motion of particles)
B) field energy
C) potential energy of height
D) light only

A ball lifted high stores
A) gravitational potential energy
B) kinetic energy
C) thermal energy
D) sound energy

Gravitational potential energy is stored in the
A) gravitational field
B) ball's color
C) sound
D) light

steps: It is stored in the gravitational field.

items.prompt:
Two magnets held apart store energy in the
A) magnetic field
B) gravitational field only
C) sound field
D) no field

steps: Energy is stored in the magnetic field.

items.prompt:
A speeding bike and a warm rock both have
A) motion energy
B) only field energy
C) no energy
D) stored potential energy

steps: Both are forms of motion energy.

items.prompt:
A book on a high shelf has energy that is
A) stored in the gravitational field
B) the motion of particles
C) kinetic energy
D) sound energy
items.answer: A) stored in the gravitational field
